patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layouts are frequently used, with one column containing large imagery or a dominant text block, and the other providing supporting text or a list.
The hero section features extremely oversized, multi-line headings that command attention, contrasting with smaller, highly legible body text and uppercase labels for sub-sections.
A muted, natural color palette dominates, primarily using a dark forest green for text and a warm, light off-white for backgrounds, creating a sophisticated and earthy feel.
Sections reveal with a subtle fade-up and slight slide-in animation as they enter the viewport during scroll, creating a smooth, guided content progression.
Content is organized into distinct, generously spaced sections, often with a full-width image or a large text block acting as a visual anchor for the section's theme.

technique_notes: Uses GSAP ScrollTrigger to reveal sections with a staggered fade-up and slight vertical translation as they enter the viewport, enhancing content discovery.
The navigation bar is sticky, transitioning from a transparent background to a solid, light background with a subtle shadow after the initial scroll, ensuring persistent access.
The hero features an oversized, multi-line heading that scrolls with the page content, creating a dramatic and impactful first impression without complex parallax.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold hero headings (~4-5x body text) with a strong, modern sans-serif, complemented by smaller, legible body text and uppercase sub-labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used for all elements, including buttons and image frames, contributing to a clean and precise aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in the hero and between major sections, creating a sense of calm and luxury, while content within sections maintains a balanced density.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, oversized, multi-line hero typography that immediately captures attention, combined with a sophisticated, muted color palette and generous white space. This creates an almost editorial, high-end feel that elevates the scientific subject matter beyond a typical corporate site.
